name: Goose
description: Rust autonomous coding agent. goosed HTTP/WS backend for the desktop app. Distributed gaggle mode runs a Manager.
fingerprint_note: goosed default-binds 127.0.0.1 + TLS-on + X-Secret-Key header (protected routes 401 without it). GET /status unauth health. Gaggle Manager binds 0.0.0.0:5115. The localhost bind is the load-bearing default mitigation.
dork_notes: DARK_CONFIRMED (2026-06-19 round-2). 127.0.0.1:3000 default (configuration.rs default_host); goosed serves NO HTML (UI is the separate Electron app), so http.html dorks=0. Vendor marker is GET /features -> JSON {features:{local-inference, code-mode}} (auth-bypass allowlisted), JSON-only = invisible to Shodan HTML index. http.html:"local-inference" "code-mode"=0. port:5115=283 generic, no discriminator. Exposure requires GOOSE_HOST=0.0.0.0 or gaggle Manager. Engine route: Censys/active-probe only.
severity_note: If reachable unauth (proxy misconfig / gaggle): arbitrary command exec on host AS THE USER (no container sandbox), provider keys + OAuth tokens from OS keyring or secrets.yaml fallback.
exposure_data: host RCE-as-user, keyring/secrets.yaml provider keys + OAuth tokens, MCP/extension reach (GitHub/Slack/Docker)
